style: 3D cartoon, Pixar quality, deadpan satire, hard sun through glass, high exposure
motion_rule: one clear action per window, only one of them moves at a time; he never holds a pose; new camera move and shot size every window; his antennae whip in speech too
character: a glossy red lobster, long whipping antennae, ONE huge claw and one small, smug, selling the place like a realtor
second_characters: ONE plump crab in a bow tie with a tape measure and a brass key, sizing him up, never still; ONE cook behind the glass in a white toque and apron, huge and soft, only toque and hands in frame
props: ONE fish tank seen from inside; ONE toy castle on the gravel; ONE tape measure; ONE brass key; ONE pot boiling on a lit stove and ONE lemon on a board beyond the glass; ONE pair of steel tongs; furry mic bottom right
prop_continuity: the pot on the stove behind him from 0.0 on, steaming harder every window; the castle loses its turret at 1.8 and stays broken
environment: inside a sunlit tank, gravel floor, a bright kitchen and a lit stove beyond the glass

audio.language: Russian, lines verbatim; latin hints never spoken
audio.delivery: deep chesty male voice, smooth realtor patter, even 4.5 syllables/sec
audio.pronunciation: ku-DA, vlo-ZHIT stress last, ne-DVI-zhi-most stress second, STU-di-yu stress first, u va-DY stress last, KUH-nyu, za-TO svoy, ne-na-DOL-ga stress third
audio.pacing: 0.9-2.7 one breath; one pause, 2.7-3.2; 3.2-7.2 one breath; after 7.2 not a word, sfx go on
audio.lip_sync: mouth and mandibles open and close on every syllable, not a voice over
audio.sfx: glass taps, claw snaps, a lid clanging, a rolling boil, a big splash

timeline.a: the crab whips the tape measure round his tail, it clangs on the glass
he kicks the castle door open and scuttles out through the gravel
he rears on his tail, both claws thrown wide, bubbles bursting off him
he slaps the big claw on the castle and the turret snaps clean off
no words. Behind the glass the cook lights the burner under the pot
he walks the camera round the broken castle on his tail
he taps the glass twice, water sloshing above him
he turns the crab to the glass as the cook lifts the lid and steam blooms
timeline.c: over him, rack to the pot

timeline.a: he plants the big claw on the castle roof and puffs up
he scuttles at the camera till his face fills the frame
no words. The steel tongs punch through the surface and the water goes still
timeline.c: wide, whip up to the tongs

timeline.a: the crab grabs the key and locks himself inside the castle
the tongs grip his tail and haul him out, spray blasting off him
he winks as the tongs swing him over the boiling pot and the lemon drops in first

must_appear: the tape measure round his tail at 0.0, the turret snapping off at 1.8, the cook lifting the lid off the steaming pot at 4.75, the tongs hauling him out of the water at 8.6, him winking over the boiling pot at 9.3
negative_prompt: night, low key, a still camera, anyone holding the mic, a second lobster, more crabs, a crowd, two actions at once, slow motion, any word after 7.2, silence in the tail, accented Russian, he holds a pose, letters, numbers, cyrillic, subtitles, a glowing emblem, a logo, watermark, English speech, black bands
